items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Miles Davis has made a career out of that. [INTERVIEWEE] That's right, and so have I.

ctx.x: If you got that, that was fine, because I learned--I think I learned more jazz from Stuie because he would always try for things and miss, but it was his recouping that made the thing--
Miles Davis has made a career out of that.
That's right, and so have I.
